<description>
Add direct unit tests for script recognition, sigop counting, opcode parsing and witness formatting. These tests detect 12 individual mutations in `src/script/script.cpp` from [mutation dataset run 21](https://bitcoincore.space/public/mutation_data.json), which used commit `859215218667ca9f35d5adae0289e4a125798087`.

| Mutant IDs | Behavior checked | Test |
|---|---|---|
| [2346](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2346), [2347](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2347), [2348](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2348) | Exact Taproot script size, version and push opcode | `script_segwit_tests/IsPayToTaproot_*` |
| [2325](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2325) | Accurate multisig counting at `OP_1` | `sigopcount_tests/GetSigOpCount` |
| [2326](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2326) | Accurate counting of the output script through the non-P2SH `scriptSig` overload | `sigopcount_tests/GetSigOpCount` |
| [2328](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2328) | Acceptance of `OP_16` directly in the outer `scriptSig`, before the redeem-script push | `sigopcount_tests/GetSigOpCount` |
| [2337](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2337) | Rejection when only one of the two anchor payload bytes matches | `script_standard_tests/script_standard_Solver_failure` |
| [2365](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2365) | Acceptance of `MAX_OPCODE` | `script_tests/script_HasValidOps` |
| [2377](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2377), [2380](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2380), [2383](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2383) | Rejection of incomplete PUSHDATA1/2/4 length fields | `script_tests/script_GetOp_truncated` |
| [2362](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/script.cpp#2362) | Witness formatting without a leading delimiter | `script_tests/script_witness_ToString` |

The mutations are applied separately. For 2377, 2380 and 2383, the exact changes replace `return false` with `return true` at the respective length-field guards in `GetScriptOp`.

2372 is excluded: the preceding `pc >= end` guard makes its mutated return unreachable for valid iterators. The earlier description incorrectly included this ID and used diff examples that did not match the dataset patches.

Validation used an AI-assisted local audit on WSL Ubuntu x86_64 with Clang 21.1.8, CMake 4.2.3, `RelWithDebInfo` and the wallet disabled:

- The four affected suites pass all 50 cases without mutations.
- Each of the 12 listed patches builds successfully and causes an assertion failure in its targeted test (exit 201).
- Each listed patch survives the same four suites at the PR parent, `ed7dd7cf4e1561a97edf72eba29a67b14e28c717`.
- Each of the four commits builds and passes the affected suites independently.

```sh
cmake --build build --target test_bitcoin -j 2
./build/bin/test_bitcoin --run_test=script_segwit_tests,script_standard_tests,script_tests,sigopcount_tests
```

Review per commit.
</description>

<new_statements>
[2026-09-29] c:5883200261 comment by Yudis-bit:
You're right about the original OP_16 test. It put OP_16 inside the serialized redeem script, so it did not exercise the outer scriptSig boundary in mutant 2328. The replacement puts OP_16 directly before the redeem-script push. With 2328 applied, it fails with `0 != 3`.

For GetOp, three of the four IDs are detected by the original tests. On [ec4d7b3bd](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/commit/ec4d7b3bdab55406f13599c2bcaf77797a1e6ec0), applying the exact dataset patches separately makes `script_tests/script_GetOp_truncated` fail at:

```text
2377: script_tests.cpp:1646: !s1.GetOp(it1, opcode, data)
2380: script_tests.cpp:1651: !s2.GetOp(it2, opcode, data)
2383: script_tests.cpp:1656: !s4.GetOp(it4, opcode, data)
```

All three builds succeed; each test exits 201. Those patches change `return false` to `return true` at the incomplete length-field checks. The diff I put in the description was wrong.

2372 was also an incorrect claim. Its return is unreachable after the preceding `pc >= end` guard for valid iterators. I've removed it from the description and commit message.

The revised tests detect all 12 retained mutants when applied individually, and all 50 cases in the four affected suites pass without mutations. The follow-up audit was AI-assisted.
</new_statements>
